detail.heading: DNS zone
detail.subtitle: The records this server answers with for the name, and how to point the name here.
detail.notFoundDescription: This zone does not exist, or it belongs to another account.

zones.heading: DNS zones
zones.subtitle: The domain names this server answers DNS queries for.
zones.emptyDescription: Create a zone to publish the DNS records of a domain from this server.
zones.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filters, or clear them to see every zone.
zones.confirmDelete: Every record in the zone is deleted and this server stops answering for the name. The domain stops resolving here until a zone is created again.

zoneForm.heading: New zone
zoneForm.subtitle: The panel checks these values before sending them, and the server checks them again.

hints.name: The domain of one of the account's sites. The server refuses a name no site of the account serves.

errors.accountRequired: Choose the account that owns the zone.
errors.nameRequired: Enter the domain name of the zone.
errors.nameInvalid: Enter a domain name of two or more parts, such as example.com.

records.emptyDescription: Add a record to publish an address, a mail server or any other data for this zone.
records.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filters, or clear them to see every record.
records.confirmDelete: The name server stops answering with this record as soon as the zone is applied.

placeholders.name: {'@'} for the zone itself, or www

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name. Use {'@'} for the zone itself.
errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, digits, hyphens and underscores in dot-separated parts. A * may stand alone as the first part.
errors.ttlInvalid: Enter the TTL as a whole number of seconds.
errors.ttlRange: The TTL must be between {min} and {max} seconds.
errors.numberRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
errors.tagInvalid: Choose one of the listed tags.
errors.valueControl: A value cannot contain line breaks or other control characters.
errors.valueTooLong: A value can be up to {max} characters long.

nameservers.heading: Nameservers
nameservers.subtitle: The name server on this host and the values written into every zone it serves.
nameservers.settingsSubtitle: Written into the SOA and the NS set of every zone.

hints.nameservers: One host name per line, such as ns1.example.com. Create glue records for them at the registrar of their domain.
hints.hostmaster: The contact address of the zones, written the way the SOA record writes it: a dot instead of the at sign, so hostmaster.example.com stands for hostmaster{'@'}example.com.
hints.rerender: Saving writes the new values into every zone on this server.

errors.nameserverInvalid: A name server must be a host name such as ns1.example.net.
errors.hostmasterInvalid: Write the mailbox with a dot instead of the at sign, such as hostmaster.example.com.
errors.ipv4Invalid: Enter an IPv4 address such as 203.0.113.10.
errors.ipv6Invalid: Enter an IPv6 address such as 2001:db8::10.

nameservers.incomplete: The settings are incomplete, so zones cannot be created yet. Fill in the primary name server and the hostmaster mailbox, then save.

server.heading: Name server
server.onExplanation: This server answers DNS queries on port 53 for the zones it holds.
server.offExplanation: This server does not answer DNS queries and port 53 is closed. Zones are kept.
server.turnedOn: The name server was turned on.
server.turnedOff: The name server was turned off.
server.confirmOn: This opens port 53 to the internet. Domains start resolving here once their registrars delegate them to this server.
server.confirmOff: This closes port 53. Every zone stops resolving from this server, and the zones are kept.
server.agentUnreachable: The panel could not reach the agent on this host, so the state below is what the panel last stored.
